story.label: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Ruang Kelas Mandarin was established to provide an accessible, structured, and relevant Mandarin learning experience for students with different learning needs.
story.paragraph2: We believe that learning a language is not only about memorizing vocabulary and understanding grammar. It should also give students opportunities to communicate, build confidence, and explore Chinese culture.
story.paragraph3: With experienced teachers, structured learning materials, and interactive teaching methods, we are committed to helping every student grow and achieve their individual learning goals.

highlightOne.label: Learning experiences that encourage students to communicate actively.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become a trusted Mandarin learning platform that helps every student develop language skills, confidence, and a broader understanding of Chinese culture.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide structured, interactive, and relevant Mandarin learning through qualified teachers and a supportive learning environment that encourages every student to grow.

approach.label: Our Approach
approach.description: We combine a structured curriculum, interactive learning methods, and guidance from experienced teachers to create an effective and engaging Mandarin learning experience.

teachers.name: Nurhayati Sommeng Abdullah, M.Pd
teachers.description: She holds a Bachelor's degree from Universitas Muhammadiyah Makassar and a Master's degree from Universitas Bosowa Makassar. With more than 17 years of experience teaching Mandarin, she has taught students from elementary school to university level. She has also participated in educational and professional training programs at East China Normal University (ECNU), Beijing Language and Culture University (BLCU), and Nanchang University (NCU), China, through the Hanban China Scholarship Program.

teachers.name: Dian Wahyuni

teachers.name: Maemunah, S.Pd
teachers.description: She focuses on teaching quality, curriculum development, and educational research to continuously improve our Mandarin language learning programs.

items.review: Learning at Ruang Kelas Mandarin has been a wonderful experience! Within 6 months, I successfully passed HSK 3 and received a scholarship to study in China.
Learning Mandarin here has been an amazing experience. The teachers are patient, supportive, and every lesson is easy to understand.
The curriculum is structured and practical. I passed my HSK exam much faster than I expected.
